about: Galactic Cat is a fast-paced arcade action game where players control a laser-wielding feline flying from right to left. Destroy waves of breakable objects and enemies while avoiding hazards and collecting power-ups. With fun gameplay and intense action, this game delivers non-stop excitement for arcade fans!
Enhanced game play on PS4 Pro console
